title: Talking head chat
summary: A Lovable bot scaffolds ChatRTK, a chat with an expressive talking face, in chatty-face-plugin. Paul takes over from 2025-05-20.
alt: ChatRTK, a green chat screen with a simple square talking face and a message box at the bottom.

title: Themes, face editor, voice
summary: Face themes, a facial rig editor and head selector land, then Paul adds Web Speech and voice synth. Mic and hotkeys follow the next day.

title: Kamiji 2D SVG face rig
summary: kamiji-rig is written in a night: SVG face, expressions, animations, themes and a phoneme interface that was only stubbed.
alt: The Kamiji Rig app showing a round pale face with two coral eyes and a pill mouth beside a theme picker.

title: Tamagotchi pet and RPG
summary: kamiji-game is generated by Lovable: a Tamagotchi pet, day cycle and a grid RPG map. Illustrator art follows on the Desktop.
alt: A purple and pink Game Collection screen with a yellow chick pet and hunger, happiness and energy bars.

title: Electron pet demo
summary: kamiji-demo, a Tamagotchi device built with Vite, React and Electron. It has no git history, so dates come from file times.
source: kamiji-demo file mtimes 2025-06-09 to 06-12, unverified authorship
alt: A pink handheld Tamagotchi style device on a dark background showing an egg, status meters and action buttons.

title: Rig finally committed
summary: After a year without commits, the 2D face rig code is committed to kamiji-rig as a Vite app with Tailwind.

title: Face plate with lip sync
summary: yakopop gets a vector face plate over painted characters: 13 channels, blinks, head look and a viseme mouth.

title: Gaze and Talk Circle
summary: Eyes follow who a character talks to. An anime expression library and voiced Talk Circle lab arrive.

title: Mochi characters
summary: The mochi kit builds blobby characters in code with a drawn dot and oval face rig. Hoof and horn variants follow.

title: Kamikin and Godot slice
summary: The Kamikin mochi pet game appears in yakopop. A Godot port slice is benchmarked the same day.
alt: The Pocket Meadow character select menu over a bright grassy world with six Kamikin choices.

title: Kosmos engine begins
summary: A Rust engine repo starts with a Cargo workspace. It later absorbs the face, rig and mochi work.

title: Mochi skinned in Rust
summary: Kosmos imports mochi as skinned bodies, faces and baked motions, and adds spoken lip sync and a face plate crate.
alt: A small pink bunny shaped mochi character standing in tall grass under a blue sky.

title: kosmos-face crate
summary: The web face brain (gaze, attention, talk, symbols) is ported to Rust and checked against goldens from the TypeScript.
alt: The Talk Circle lab in the Kosmos editor, with two circles of speakers showing who looks at whom.

title: Morph targets in glTF
summary: Morph targets flow through glTF import, export and skinned meshes, with weights playable on a shot. Mochi and hose labs go live.
alt: A hoof and horn lab with a row of small pastel mochi animals standing on a green field.

title: Rust TTS client
summary: Kosmos gains a client for the local text to speech server, a step toward voice driven mouths.

title: Viseme and rig engine
summary: Phonemes, a 15 viseme table, coarticulation, ARKit shapes and an export map land, with plans for hand authored rigs.

title: Phoneme timings from voices
summary: The voices server emits ARPAbet phoneme timings in a header (RIG.12), so mouths can follow the actual speech.

title: 3D hand avatar
summary: A Meshy based chubby hand is rebuilt in Blender with a finger skeleton, morph target face, poses and clips. Kamiji turns 3D.
alt: A glossy yellow cartoon hand with a smiling face on the palm against a plain grey background.

title: Legacy rig merged
summary: The original 2D SVG face rig is merged into the Kamiji repo under legacy with its history kept.
alt: The original Kamiji Rig app showing a round pale face with two coral eyes and a pill mouth beside a theme picker.

title: Kamikin as GLBs
summary: Fourteen Kamikin mochi are converted into skinned, animated GLBs with swappable face state textures.
alt: Three rows of six face textures in neutral, happy, joy, sad, surprised and blink states for three Kamikin characters.

title: Emoji props library
summary: Twenty four procedural clay style 3D props, then a larger emoji library with role coloured materials.

title: Licence and landing page
summary: Code is MIT, characters are CC BY-NC with a premium licence. A minimalist landing page with a model carousel ships.

title: Agent Canvas integration
summary: The library is vendored into OpenHands Agent Canvas for feed and agent avatars. The work is still uncommitted.
